canonical_source.behavior: Expose the public Welcome route under the source page's explicit AllowAnonymous boundary. This closure is limited to route exposure; separate Welcome visible controls remain independently reconciled.

laravel_adaptation.behavior: The explicit web-only Laravel route renders the existing real AI WordPress Manager public entry view. The route carries a distinct canonical route marker while preserving the independently terminal public-brand visible-control marker.

authorization.fail_closed: The route accepts no tenant, user, site, or resource identifier and resolves no TenantContext or TenantAuthorizer; query input is not reflected into the response.

tenant_isolation.proof: Focused acceptance compares anonymous and authenticated callers while injecting distinct tenant/user sentinels and hostile query values; rendered content remains identity-neutral and discloses none of them.

validation_and_degraded_states.anonymous: allowed by source contract and returns the real public product entry
validation_and_degraded_states.authenticated: returns the same tenant/user-neutral public route shell; auth-aware Welcome controls remain separate canonical operations
validation_and_degraded_states.query_override: ignored for tenant/user authority and not reflected

persistence_and_runtime.csrf: not applicable to GET/read-only route exposure
persistence_and_runtime.idempotency: GET route is read-only and repeatable
persistence_and_runtime.retry: Normal browser retry is side-effect free.
persistence_and_runtime.secrets: no provider, credential, tenant, user, or query secret is rendered

acceptance_tests.coverage: canonical operation identity, explicit source AllowAnonymous proof, exact route/action binding, web-only middleware, absence of auth and tenant.context, zero route parameters, real public product rendering rather than the stock Laravel placeholder, identity/tenant/query non-disclosure, and preservation of the separate existing Welcome visible-control marker

terminality.basis: The canonical /welcome route is explicitly bound to the real public Welcome controller/view under source-equivalent anonymous, zero-parameter, tenant-neutral semantics with deterministic identity non-disclosure acceptance.
